body:
Our Larimar Tumbled Stone is like holding a piece of serene ocean in your hand. Found only in the Dominican Republic, Larimar is treasured for its soothing blue tones and swirling white patterns that resemble sunlight playing across tropical waves. Energetically, it’s known as a stone of tranquility, emotional healing and Divine Feminine wisdom.

Each tumbled piece is unique, with its own mix of pale sky blues, aquas and soft white marbling. The smooth, polished finish makes it perfect to hold during meditation, carry in a pocket, or place on the body during energy work. Larimar’s gentle appearance reflects its energy: calming, nurturing and deeply reassuring.

Associated with the Throat and Heart chakras, Larimar supports clear, compassionate communication and emotional release. It’s especially supportive if you feel overwhelmed, anxious or out of touch with your own softness. Working with Larimar can feel like a cooling wave washing over a stressed nervous system, inviting you to slow down, breathe and respond from a place of calm.

Keep a Larimar Tumbled Stone on your desk, beside your bed, or in any space where you want more peace. It’s a wonderful ally for sensitive souls, empaths and healers, as well as anyone cultivating gentler self‑talk and healthier emotional boundaries. Larimar can also support you in reconnecting with playfulness, creativity and receptive, intuitive energy.
